checks.area: Mendeley v1 versus the author mirror: José decision?
evidence: The worker logged 'recover from checksummed Mendeley v1' as an agent choice. Preferring checksummed, DOI-versioned bytes would be the conventional default if the two sources were equivalent. They are not.

convert_gtech_2021_phase_to_parquet.m reads ik_offset as a core channel (line 73) and estimates segment lengths from static markers (line 152). The crosswalk's own AB17 blocker says: 'Publisher v1 lacks ik_offset/static; converter cannot substitute ik without documented processing.'

So the source choice decides what can happen to the six missing participants. (A) Mendeley v1: verifiable bytes and a citable version, but without static or ik_offset. They would need a different processing recipe from the other 16 (a mixed-version cohort) or remain partly unconvertible. (B) Author's 2024 mirror: likely consistent with the local 16, which carry static and ik_offset, but with no publisher checksums, so LocoHub would record its own hashes at download. (C) Keep the cohort at 16 and document six participants as unavailable. Each option is acceptable and each changes scope or processing consistency.

AGENTS.md reserves scientific judgments and scope to José and says to ask when a choice has more than one acceptable option. This qualifies. It is not urgent: defer is allowed, and the cost of waiting is only that the six stay unrecovered.

The size-order rule is neutral and the AB15 metadata is correct. But AB15 is another v1 archive that will hit the same ik_offset/static blocker as AB17. Its condition (AB17 extracted and schema pilot accepted) checks structure, not whether v1 participants can be processed like the other 16.

The decisive unknown for both options is whether the 2024 update changed shared channels (ik, id, fp, etc.) relative to v1. A v1 archive of a participant already held locally would answer it by comparing members against the local tree; the smallest such archive is AB14 at 957,109,717 bytes. That is one candidate. Alternatively, the next acquisition waits for José's source decision.
Either way, the next bounded action should follow from resolving the v1-versus-2024 question, not from size order alone.
